dataset.name: flywire
dataset.weight_scale_source: male CNS connectome paper (Cell 2026, S0092-8674(26)00942-6): calibration of male CNS vs FAFB/FlyWire synapse detection

model.sign_rule: GABA & glutamate -1 (Liu & Wilson 2013), ACh/DA/OA/5-HT +1 (Shiu et al. 2024); histamine -1 (HisCl, Hardie 1989 - pipeline decision)

params_table.name: tau_syn
params_table.source: Juergensen et al. 2021 (via Shiu 2024; excitatory value applied to all synapses as in Shiu)

params_table.name: t_refractory
params_table.source: Lazar et al. 2021 / Kakaria & de Bivort 2017 (via Shiu 2024)

params_table.name: W_syn
params_table.source: Shiu et al. 2024 (free parameter, fit on FlyWire v630)

params_table.name: weight_scale
params_table.source: male CNS paper (Cell 2026) synapse-count calibration vs FlyWire; user-supplied, checked in stage 0

params_table.name: sign(histamine)
params_table.source: Hardie 1989 Nature 339:704 (HisCl); pipeline decision beyond Shiu 2024

params_table.name: sign(unknown NT)
params_table.source: no source: neurons with no NT prediction default to excitatory (count reported in manifest)
